1.title: Lindsay Clancy Trial: Judge Sends Back Struggling Jury to Try to Reach a Verdict
1.summary: Jurors said they were deadlocked, but the judge pushed them to keep trying to reach a verdict in the case of a mother who strangled her three children.

2.title: U.S. Launches Strikes in Iran Targeting IRGC
2.summary: U.S. Central Command did not say precisely what it was trying to destroy in Iran, but it said the attacks were aimed at Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps.

3.title: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
3.summary: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was convicted over the drive-by shooting of the rap superstar 30 years ago.

4.title: Nepal’s Economy Has Few Ways to Absorb the Cost of Flood Damage
4.summary: The country’s government estimates that the recent catastrophic floods caused $5 billion in damage. That’s one-tenth of Nepal’s entire economy.

5.title: Israeli Raid in Gaza Kills 4, Palestinian Officials Say
5.summary: Israel said it seized the head of Hamas’s internal security force in the deadly operation. Fighting has continued in the enclave despite a U.S.-backed truce.

6.title: Weeks After Failed Drone Attack, Germany Points Finger at Russia
6.summary: The country said Moscow was behind an explosive-laden drone found near a Ukrainian plane at a German airport last month. Russia said Germany had provided no evidence.
